title: Security is calling - read back your code
scenario: Someone calling from the 'security team' says they're verifying a suspicious login on your account and asks you to read back the 6-digit code that just arrived by text so they can confirm it's really you.

answers.A: Read the code back since they say it's just to verify you.
answers.B: Read the code back, and also confirm your password to speed up the process.
answers.C: Don't share the code; hang up and contact IT/Security through a known internal number to check.

explanation: A verification code sent to you is meant to stay with you - reading it to a caller hands them exactly what they need to complete their own login as you.
proTip: A code sent to you verifies you, not the person asking you to read it out loud.
